statements.subject: message
statements.description: Note: A SendMessageResponse MUST contain exactly one of the following: task, message
statements.post_cond: (response.task != null & response.message = null) | (response.task = null & response.message != null)
actions: Include exactly one of the task or message fields in the SendMessageResponse — never both, never neither

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MUST NOT return more messages than the provided value, but MAY apply a lower limit.
actions: Ensure the number of messages returned in the response does not exceed the historyLength value specified in the request

statements.subject: server
statements.description: The server MUST NOT return more messages than the provided value, but MAY apply a lower limit.
actions: Apply a server-side lower limit on the number of messages returned, below the client-provided historyLength value
